summary: Scorpio Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications for the six months ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine periodic reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer, incorporating exhibits into its F-10 registration statement. No special-situation event—such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring—is disclosed. The filing is purely informational and does not warrant classification as a special situation.
